t: Wiping an injury with earth and saliva
a: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا لِيُشْفَى بِهِ سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا
p: Bismillāh, turbatu arḍinā bi-rīqati baʿḍinā, yushfā bihi saqīmunā bi-idhni rabbinā.
m: In the name of Allah, the earth of our land with the saliva of some of us, by which our sick one is cured, by the permission of our Lord.
